note: Report a factual error through the public issue tracker. Include the page, the claim and a source. Corrections are recorded here with the date and the affected page.

entries.claim: The 2026-10-24 Dundee United 3-2 Aberdeen result appeared on the fixture pages but not in the league table, form guide, analysis hero, history record or club summary.
entries.correction: The official SPFL overlay now writes a complete league result row; every table-driven surface reads the same canonical result frame. The table, form, history, analysis and coverage now report the result.

entries.claim: The 2024-25 Scottish Cup final was labelled FA Cup and described as a draw.
entries.correction: Competition labels resolve through the competition registry; the shootout outcome is named in the headline, H1 and honours record.

entries.claim: Scottish Cup fixtures carried the provider label FA Cup.
entries.correction: All fixture and player competition labels use the canonical Scottish Cup name.

entries.claim: A dismissal after two yellow cards was shown as a straight red.
entries.correction: Second yellows are derived from prior yellow-card events and shown as second yellow.

entries.claim: Multi-goal defeats were headlined win it late.
entries.correction: The late-win phrase now requires a one-goal margin and a decisive late goal.

entries.claim: An unavailable event feed was described as recording 0 goals.
entries.correction: The read now says the event feed is unavailable and does not print a zero.

entries.claim: Duplicate 2022 pre-season fixtures inflated the match record.
entries.correction: Duplicate records are aliases of the canonical match and are excluded from counts, search and navigation.

entries.claim: Unknown availability was rendered as 0 known / 0 unknown and 0% risk.
entries.correction: Unknown availability is null and labelled unknown; opponent availability is not modelled.

entries.claim: The review said the club avoided a relegation fight.
entries.correction: The review states the measured finish: 10th on 41 points, in the bottom six.
